declined.subject: document-text-extraction
declined.reason: The document-text-extraction standard governs converting untrusted document byte containers (PDFs, scanned images, office files) into text for indexing or model consumption, enforcing completeness through typed unreadable-region refusals, extraction yield bands (complete, sparse, corrupt, empty), structural amplification caps, and optical recognition escalation. By contrast, console-brain-page is a frontend React UI for the operator console that visualizes engine telemetry, canvas pulse lanes (Plot.tsx, draw.ts), engine throughput/latency instruments (Instruments.tsx, Engine.tsx), and virtualized transcript event streams (Viewer.tsx). Its registry-map association was a lexical false positive on 'page' (web page routing in index.ts) and 'bands' (CSS/SVG letterbox art in BandArt.tsx, bands.test.tsx), containing no document ingestion or text extraction pipelines.
